innovations.name: Vertical Farming
innovations.description: Multi-layered indoor farms grow crops using LED lighting and controlled environments, maximizing space and reducing water usage—perfect for urban areas.

innovations.name: Drone Technology
innovations.description: Drones provide real-time data on crop health, irrigation needs, and pest control—allowing precise, efficient farm management.

innovations.name: AI & Smart Farming
innovations.description: Artificial intelligence predicts crop trends, analyzes soil data, and improves decision-making, paving the way for smarter, data-driven farming.
